alpha_method.decoder: Pure JavaScript native PNG RGBA8, non-interlaced: IDAT zlib/deflate, filter reconstruction, Adler32 verification
alpha_method.foot_contact: alpha > 96 in last ceil(1.5% of bbox height) rows; crop is bbox expanded by 3 px and clamped to native image
alpha_method.anchorX: midpoint of min/max support extent, normalized within crop; mean pixel center also included for audit
alpha_method.note: Many body pixels have alpha 252-254. RGB haze visible in some previews can have alpha 0; step samples at (20%,30%) and (10%,50%) both alpha 0. Pixels were not cleaned, flattened, recolored or re-encoded.

limitations: Art continuity is strong against inspected project refs; exact canonical 1:1 wardrobe/device dimensions are not certified because official imagery could not be inspected as usable pixels in this hosted pass.
Recent detailed movement sources were not re-read in pixels in this pass, only their published manifest. Comparison after integration remains necessary.
The generator provided complete silhouettes but tighter outer margins than requested in some poses; preserve native source and use geometry crop/anchors for integration.

Ground contacts are geometric pixel measurements, not a semantic detector: action and hit lowest bands mainly select the lower/rear shoe. Initial render calibration may need adjustment after browser playtesting.
No local computer access, no browser/game visual QA, and no claims of tested runtime integration.

assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve and high-resolution material upgrade. Create ONE individual full-body transparent raster character asset for the existing Death Stranding 2D game. There are TWO most recent reference images: image 1 is the established Heartman portrait and gives the exact face, glasses, upper outfit and chest apparatus; image 2 is his existing small full-body neutral stance and gives body proportions, complete outfit and body-side equipment placement. Recreate this SAME adult middle-aged Heartman character as detailed realistic hand-painted game art at high resolution, preserving his recognizable Nicolas Winding Refn-like face from the reference: lean natural adult build, short swept brown hair with a little gray at the temples, clean-shaven long angular face, straight nose, thin lips, thin dark rectangular glasses. Keep the blue fabric blazer with rolled sleeves and visible pale-gray shirt cuffs, light-gray button-up shirt without tie, small existing lapel pin, ochre-orange diagonal harness strap, compact amber/orange rectangular chest defibrillator with small cyan glowing indicator and corner hardware, black horizontal strap, metallic band on the NEAR/anatomical RIGHT upper arm, cyan wrist device on that same near/right wrist, dark fingerless gloves with actual human fingertips, charcoal straight trousers and worn dark-blue low-top lace-up sneakers with white rubber soles. Preserve the exact number and body-side placement of devices and straps. Bare visible hair and ears as referenced; do not add a helmet, headset, cap, coat, backpack, armor or new equipment. PRIMARY POSE: neutral grounded STANCE, upright relaxed posture facing RIGHT in lateral view, both arms naturally down near his sides, hands relaxed, feet a modest natural distance apart and both soles planted at the same ground level. Adult natural anatomy, slim but not emaciated, no exaggerated muscles, no doll joints. Tactile blazer weave, subtle seam stitching, natural skin and face detail, believable fingers, soft cloth folds, lightly worn leather gloves and shoes, restrained metal and glass highlights. Soft cool studio directional light, no heavy ink outlines, no cell-shading, no vector flats. Show the complete head, every visible fingertip and both whole shoes/soles, with 8-10 percent transparent breathing room at all outer edges. Exactly one character and one pose, no montage, no spritesheet, no grid, no duplicate. TRUE ALPHA TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND everywhere outside the silhouette. Remove the old reference's gray RGB haze from the visible output: no backdrop, floor, ground shadow, checkerboard, halo, smoke or effects. No labels, text or watermark. Preserve identity and costume rather than redesigning.
